usageNote: 名词短语！说某人打破/创造纪录就用break/set the world record，超级常用，体育新闻里随处见！

examples.en: She broke the world record for the 100m sprint last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚打破了百米短跑的世界纪录。

examples.en: He has been trying to set the world record for the longest time without sleep.
examples.zh: 他一直在尝试创造最长不睡觉时间的世界纪录。
